description: Fish Audio S2 Pro text-to-speech model for expressive speech across 80+ languages, with automatic language handling, inline prosody/emotion controls, and rapid voice cloning from short reference samples.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Reference transcript; required with inline reference audio.

request.name: multi_reference_cond
request.description: Fish Audio ordered JSON array of reference conditioning pairs for one generated speaker: [{"audio":"ref1.wav","text":"Transcript one."},{"audio":"ref2.wav","text":"Transcript two."}]. This is not a multi-speaker dialogue routing option.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum Fish Audio semantic tokens to generate; default 1024. Zero selects the default token budget.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum characters per generated text chunk; default 200.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking mode; default word_budget.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed for reproducible output; omitted uses a random seed.

session.name: lora
session.description: Prepared Fish Speech adapter checkpoint; merged into slow/fast decoder and embedding weights at session creation. Codec weights are unchanged.

session.name: lora_scale
session.description: Multiplier for the adapter's alpha/r scaling; default 1.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release cached AR runtime graphs after each request; default false.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: AR matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: codec_weight_type
session.description: Codec conv/matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: codec_encoder_bf16_compute
session.description: Use BF16 reference-encoder arithmetic on CUDA with F16/BF16 codec weights; default false. Decoding is unchanged.

session.name: ar_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AR runtime graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: ar_weight_context_mb
session.description: AR weight context size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: codec_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec encode/decode graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_weight_context_mb
session.description: Codec weight context size in MiB; default 32.
